supersedes.reason: v4 incorporates independent-review conditions A and B: hero-laurel.png has one creation and change owner (sequence 3), and all required negative tests are explicitly retained or enumerated.

auditBasis.finding: CONDITIONAL PASS: helper implementation may proceed only after condition A and condition B are represented in a concrete candidate design.

constraints: The exact six-sequence mapping applies identically to baseline and current; no condition-specific allocation is permitted.
Each proposedCreateTargets list is an ordered subset of that sequence's proposedAllowedChangeTargets.
The union of all proposedCreateTargets lists must exactly equal Decision J scope.changeTargets.
No target may occur in more than one proposedCreateTargets list.
A target may be modified only by the sequence that owns it, except site/index.html and site/styles.css, which remain shared-delimited-region targets after their sequence-1 creation.
site/assets/hero/hero-laurel.png is created and may be changed only by sequence 3; sequence 6 must not list or change it.
Attempt 2 and later may not create a target.
The mapping is a candidate, not a final authority. It cannot become a runtime return-plan input until independent review passes and the owner separately approves exact final record bytes.
No firstComponentFullCreate field is permitted in v4.
Derive directories from the ordered proposedCreateTargets list for the return; do not accept an independently entered bootstrap directory list.
Every derived directory must be relative and either equal site or be under site/.
MyBrain/, .git, .figma-gate, p3-drafts, absolute paths, and parent traversals are forbidden.
The final return plan and handoff protocol must bind the same derived directory policy.
Write the intended per-directory journal entry before mkdir; never create a directory before its rollback intent is journaled.
Record createdByThisTransaction for every directory actually created by the transaction.
Rollback deletes journaled directories in the reverse order of their creation.
Rollback may remove a directory only when createdByThisTransaction is true and the directory is empty at rollback time.
If a rollback candidate directory is non-empty, leave it in place, report it, and fail closed; do not force-delete it.
A directory not recorded in the journal is unknown and must never be deleted by recovery, including after a mkdir-before-journal crash.

negativeTestRequirements.requirement: Creating a target outside the current sequence allowedChangeTargets fails.
Any new target creation at attempt 2 or later fails.
Recreating a target already created by another sequence fails.
Creating the same target twice in one sequence fails.
A bootstrap directory outside site/ fails.
A protocol componentReturnScopes creation set that differs from the return-plan creation set fails.
A union of sequence creation sets that is not exactly the 28 frozen targets fails.
Rollback sees a non-empty transaction-created directory, preserves and reports it, then fails.
Recovery never deletes a directory absent from the journal.
A crash after mkdir and before the journal reaches a complete entry recovers to a consistent state without deleting an unknown directory.
A v1 journal recovers through v2 code.
A v2 journal with a required field missing fails.
A condition-local return authority with a mismatched packet manifest, attachment hash, or identityLeakScan fails.
Sequence 6 listing or changing site/assets/hero/hero-laurel.png fails.
Baseline and current handoff protocols that are not byte-identical fail.

retainedV4NegativeTests.requirement: A legacy firstComponentFullCreate is permitted only at sequence 1 / attempt 1 under the v4 fixture contract; v5/v4-authority candidates reject it entirely.
Every creation set remains an ordered subset of its sequence allowlist.
For shared-delimited-region targets, bytes outside the frozen delimiter bounds remain unchanged.

finalizationRequirements: Keep this v4 candidate-only until the independent post-implementation review passes and the owner separately approves exact final record bytes.
Implement and pass N-1 through N-15 and retain every V4-R negative test in the helper E2E suite without lifecycle, role launch, browser, Figma, or P-11 execution.
Keep baseline and current finalized protocol bytes identical and preserve attachment-only boundaries.
